description: A bed with a pink pillow is in front, with a small white drawer box, a matching drawer insert, and a larger white box frame on the blanket. The left hand reaches forward to steady the larger box frame while the right hand grasps the small drawer insert and slides it forward into the opening, aligning it and pushing it in until it sits like a drawer; then both hands ease off, leaving the small drawer box to the left and the assembled drawer unit on the right.
